about: The files that decide a verdict. `fromMain` is the gate's definition: every Validate job runs main's copy of these against the change (scripts/ci-main-gate.sh, read from main), so a change is judged by main's checks plus the checks only it adds, matched by group and id (judgedChecks in scripts/run-checks.mjs). `files` are every gate file, as exact paths or prefixes ending in / or -: the scope job warns when a change touches one, and pnpm merge:ready refuses it until it carries the gate-reviewed label, which the merge desk adds only when the lead names the pull request and head. Every script a config/checks.json command runs directly, every config file a check's tool reads by default or by a config flag (vitest, tsc with the tsconfigs it extends and references, playwright), and every script those import from scripts/, is a gate file too: loadGateList adds the ones this list does not name (checkedScripts in scripts/gate-files.mjs), so a new checker or helper is covered without an entry. Tests are not gate files: a change may add and change its own tests.
